reserveReview.rationale: At HyperEVM block 52378604 (2026-11-27T10:55:54Z, hash 0xa9b0c1ba9f6c84d8631f39ebaf8481da888d018971d5992b2416b2a3a00c4b00), USDV totalSupply() was 364,591.267813 USDV against $557,802.57 in measured collateral (~153.0% collateralization) across the Stablecoin Vault (300,895.928332 USDC = $300,857.41 and 501.380526 USDT0 = $500.76 plus negligible residual WHYPE/kHYPE), the USDC PSM (104,727.579629 USDC total: 20,862.887243 idle EVM buffer plus 83,864.692386 deployed to its HyperCore executor against 104,715.460475 USDV PSM liabilities; USDT0 PSM liabilities were zero), and the HYPE/kHYPE Vault (1,883.330409 kHYPE = $127,807.43 and 360.628722 WHYPE = $23,780.48 valued at live Chainlink answers). Because vault and PSM collateral is deployed via CoreWriter into HyperCore strategy executors rather than held as static ERC-20 balances on HyperEVM adapters, Pharos uses curated-validated with live HyperEVM totalSupply() checks rather than evm-branch-balances.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Pinned HyperEVM totalCollateral() and PSM balance accounting valued via Delpho's on-chain Chainlink feeds at block 52378604 (2026-11-27T10:55:54Z)
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: All four collateral types and amounts are read directly from Delpho's on-chain vault and PSM accounting contracts; real-time HyperCore perpetual margin PnL and executor position state outside EVM vault accounting are not independently verified by a third-party auditor.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Collateral is deposited into smart contracts on HyperEVM and actively deployed via CoreWriter into HyperCore strategy and delta-neutral hedging executors (rehypothecation is inherent to the yield-generating vault and PSM design). There is no legal bankruptcy-remote custody wrapper, and protocol contracts remain UUPS-upgradeable by the 3-of-4 V1 admin multisig without a timelock.
